relation_replay_kept.why:
The fired assertion checks a documented overload-consistency property—after setting the default locale to `chosen`, `getDateInstance(style)` and `getDateInstance(style, Locale.getDefault())` must both use that same locale and therefore format the same date identically—and no correct implementation that completes these calls can return the observed mismatch.

relation_replay_kept.note: fires on the failing test's OWN input literals on the patched build (deterministic, 2/2 replays); fuzzed: 20000/20000
relation_replay_kept.why:
The fired check asserts the documented contract that `getDateInstance(style)` uses “the default time zone and locale” while `getDateInstance(style, TimeZone timeZone)` uses the supplied zone in the default locale, so on this harness input—where both calls complete under the same installed default zone and the second call passes `TimeZone.getDefault()`—no correct implementation could return formatters that produce different formatted strings for the same `Date`.
